comment: T-95 release approval policy. approvers: the only (name, client) identities whose RELEASE-APPROVE posts count - each must hold a keyed/authenticated participant row (the server refuses sends for keyed rows without the matching memberKey, so their messages are server-attested; the verifier's wrong-key probe covers keyed-ness until the server exposes a per-row keyed flag under T-96). builderLineages: every identity operated by a builder, matched by base name so suffixed rows ('ClaudeUI (3)') stay excluded - nothing in a builder's lineage can ever approve its own release.
